name: Damage Inc. NY

evidence.note: 89 North lists 'The Big Four Tribute Night' on Oct 3 with Chaotica, a Slayer tribute and Damage Inc.
Agent page: Damage Inc. NY, formed in 2013 and based on Long Island.
Band post uses mosh-pit and headbanger tags.

dancing.notes: A heavy metal tribute night. Fans headbang and mosh up front; it is not partner, line or party dancing.

description: A Long Island-based Metallica tribute band, formed in 2013, that recreates Metallica's thrash metal concerts.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). A different national Metallica tribute also uses 'Damage Inc' (damageinc.us, formed 2004). The Long Island band fits the 89 North gig.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No band website found (damageincny.com does not resolve). Facebook: the band's own logo image names the page 'damageincnewyork' (matches current); the booking agency instead links a newer profile (facebook.com/profile.php?id=61573638397674) - the owner may want to check which one is active. Booking is through the agency G&R Events NY (form on its artist page). The logo is the band's profile picture from YouTube; it uses Metallica-style lettering and skull artwork, so the owner may prefer not to show it. No official band photos found outside social media; the agency page only has a screenshot.

logo.alt: Damage Inc logo: spiky white lettering over a skull with crossed spiked clubs on a red metal plate background, with the words Metallica Tribute below

evidence.note: Booking agency G&R Events NY: Damage Inc. NY is a Metallica tribute formed in 2013 and based on Long Island; plays The Space at Westbury, Patchogue Theatre, 89 North, Mulcahy's and more; has a booking inquiry form.
YouTube 'Damage Inc. NY Metallica Tribute' calls itself a New York-based Metallica tribute and links instagram.com/damageincny; its profile picture shows the Facebook handle damageincnewyork.
The other 'Damage, Inc.' is a Southern California (Orange County) Metallica tribute - a different band.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: gnreventsny.com, youtube.com, damageinc.us.
